effects: Signing lets a Lombard claimer call mintWithFee or batchMintWithFee to mint the signer's pending BTC deposit as LBTC and take a fee of up to `fee` LBTC (8 decimals) from the minted amount.
The fee goes to the Lombard treasury, which is a value in storage, not in the message.
The approval is valid only on the chain whose id equals block.chainid, and only until `expiry` (Actions.feeApproval reverts after it).
The signed message has no nonce and names no deposit, so the same signature covers every mint with fee for the signer until expiry.
No LBTC leaves the signer's existing balance; the fee only reduces what a future mint delivers.
formats.shown: The screen shows 'Lombard Network Fee Authorization' with Chain ID 1, Max Network Fee in LBTC and an Expiry date.

findings.title: feeApproval intent does not say the fee comes out of the LBTC minted to the signer.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json feeApproval: "intent": "Lombard Network Fee Authorization", field label "Max Network Fee". StakedLBTC.mintWithFee: "@notice Mint LBTC applying a commission to the amount ... @param feePayload Contents of the fee approval signed by the user" and the call to $.assetRouter.mintWithFee(mintPayload, proof, feePayload, userSignature).
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Approve fee taken from your LBTC mint" and the label to "Max fee per mint". Add an interpolatedIntent like "Allow Lombard to take up to {fee} from minted LBTC until {expiry}".

findings.title: feeApproval reads as one fee, but the signature has no nonce and covers every mint until expiry.
findings.evidence: Actions.sol: keccak256("feeApproval(uint256 chainId,uint256 fee,uint256 expiry)") has no nonce and no deposit id. Actions.feeApproval only checks `block.timestamp > expiry` and `fee == 0`. BaseLBTC.getFeeDigest hashes only block.chainid, fee and expiry.
findings.fix: Change the label of `expiry` to "Valid for all mints until" and say "per mint" in the fee label.

findings.title: feeApproval: the fee recipient (treasury) and any router cap come from storage, not the message.
findings.evidence: StakedLBTC.getTreasury returns _getStakedLBTCStorage().treasury. The fee is applied inside IAssetRouter.mintWithFee, whose source is not in this directory.

findings.title: feeApproval test case signs a 3,000,000 LBTC fee, not a realistic value.
findings.evidence: cases/0.json: message fee "300000000000000" renders as "Max Network Fee": "3000000 LBTC". StakedLBTC.decimals returns 8. The value looks like it was picked for 18 decimals.
findings.fix: Use a realistic fee in the test, for example 30000 (0.0003 LBTC).

couldNotCheck: IAssetRouter.mintWithFee / batchMintWithFee (address held in StakedLBTC storage, source not in the directory) applies the signed fee: how much is deducted (the signed fee or a lower cap), who receives it, and whether a signature can be reused across mints could not be confirmed.
